data.one_liner: Flutter video player package for YouTube and direct video URLs with adaptive controls.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single widget API to handle both YouTube videos and direct streaming URLs (MP4, HLS, DASH) with adaptive player selection. Includes cross-platform support with unified controls, PiP, anti-screen capture, and caching.
use_when: You need to play both YouTube videos and direct video URLs within the same app.
You require cross-platform video playback supporting Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web.
You need advanced features like PiP, chapters, speed adjustments, and anti-screen capture.
avoid_when: You only need lightweight local audio playback without video rendering.
You want a minimal, dependency-free wrapper around the core video player.
strengths: Supports both YouTube and direct video URLs in a single widget.
Broad cross-platform support including desktop and web.
Rich set of built-in features like PiP, anti-screen capture, and persistence caching.
weaknesses: Relies on platform-specific setup and dependencies (e.g., CocoaPods, NuGet, WebKit/GTK).
Large dependency tree with multiple internal video packages.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform permissions for internet/background audio, plus platform-specific configuration for Android Manifest, iOS Info.plist, Windows NuGet, and Linux WebKit/GTK.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need official, lightweight video playback for direct URLs without YouTube or heavy custom controls.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your primary requirement is advanced, feature-rich audio streaming and playback rather than video.
